podcast.title: Cult Pop Punk/Garage Rock Band
podcast.body: Bass Drum of Death was cited as an example of a "culty band" that plumbed Pop Punk styles in the 2010s, sometimes taking things harder and mixing in elements of garage rock. These bands kept the spirit of Pop Punk alive during a decade when it experienced a brief surge, though not reaching the popularity of its 90s and 2000s waves. "Some examples included waves, bass drum of death, Thai seagull and Toronto's pop."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 4: The Revivals
